typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RU as integer,
		DCOrder as short,
		RA_PowerAvailablePercent as double,
		SpaceAvailablePercent as integer,
		UPS_Committed as integer,
		PowerConsumed_kW as double,
		SpaceConsumed_SF as double,
		Product as string,
		SquareFootFactorPercent as integer,
		SpaceConsumedPercent as integer,
		SpaceAvailable_SF as double,
		TotalCU as double,
		ConsumedCU as double,
		ETLUser as string,
		TotalSpace as integer,
		SiteLifecycle as string,
		RA_PowerAvailable_kW as double,
		Density_SF as double,
		InsertTs as timestamp,
		Total_Consumed as integer,
		CoLocationSite as string,
		AvailableCU as double,
		PowerAvailable_kW as double,
		RA as integer,
		TotalPower as double,
		PowerConsumedPercent as integer,
		DCType as string,
		EightyFivePercentOuterBoundary as string,
		CUAvailablePercent as integer,
		CUConsumedPercent as integer,
		PowerAvailablePercent as integer,
		Density_CU as double,
		DC as string,
		CapacityManagementFrequency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		RU as integer,
		DCOrder as short,
		RA_PowerAvailablePercent as double,
		SpaceAvailablePercent as integer,
		UPS_Committed as integer,
		PowerConsumed_kW as double,
		SpaceConsumed_SF as double,
		Product as string,
		SquareFootFactorPercent as integer,
		SpaceConsumedPercent as integer,
		SpaceAvailable_SF as double,
		TotalCU as double,
		ConsumedCU as double,
		ETLUser as string,
		TotalSpace as integer,
		SiteLifecycle as string,
		RA_PowerAvailable_kW as double,
		Density_SF as double,
		InsertTs as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Total_Consumed as integer,
		CoLocationSite as string,
		AvailableCU as double,
		PowerAvailable_kW as double,
		RA as integer,
		TotalPower as double,
		PowerConsumedPercent as integer,
		DCType as string,
		EightyFivePercentOuterBoundary as string,
		CUAvailablePercent as integer,
		CUConsumedPercent as integer,
		PowerAvailablePercent as integer,
		Density_CU as double,
		DC as string,
		CapacityManagementFrequency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RU,
		DCOrder,
		RA_PowerAvailablePercent,
		SpaceAvailablePercent,
		UPS_Committed,
		PowerConsumed_kW,
		SpaceConsumed_SF,
		Product,
		SquareFootFactorPercent,
		SpaceConsumedPercent,
		SpaceAvailable_SF,
		TotalCU,
		ConsumedCU,
		ETLUser,
		TotalSpace,
		SiteLifecycle,
		RA_PowerAvailable_kW,
		Density_SF,
		InsertTs,
		Total_Consumed,
		CoLocationSite,
		AvailableCU,
		PowerAvailable_kW,
		RA,
		TotalPower,
		PowerConsumedPercent,
		DCType,
		EightyFivePercentOuterBoundary,
		CUAvailablePercent,
		CUConsumedPercent,
		PowerAvailablePercent,
		Density_CU,
		DC,
		CapacityManagementFrequency),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
